grounded_facts: Snow White tells William to pick up the wounded magpie.
memories.memory_text: I remember Snow White telling me to pick up the wounded magpie.

grounded_facts: William justifies not picking up the bird by claiming it is dying and does not want to be touched.
memories.memory_text: I said it was dying and didn't want to be touched, so I wouldn't pick it up.

grounded_facts: Snow White approaches, calms, and picks up a wounded magpie despite William's hesitation and claim that it is dying.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White approach the bird, calm it by stroking its feathers, and then pick it up herself.

grounded_facts: Snow White and William run from the seaside village toward the castle, carrying a wounded bird.
A daytime scene in a beautiful seaside village with thatched homes, flower gardens, happy farmers, and fair village maidens.
memories.memory_text: I ran after Snow White through the sunny seaside village with its thatched homes and flower gardens, both of us carrying the wounded bird as we rushed toward the castle.

grounded_facts: Snow White urges William to hurry as they run toward the castle.
memories.memory_text: I heard Snow White tell me to hurry as we were running, her voice urgent, so I pushed myself to move faster toward the castle.

grounded_facts: Snow White enters her parents' bedroom with a wounded magpie found in the woods, initiating care for the bird.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White burst into her parents' chamber and say, 'We found it in the woods,' holding a wounded magpie.

grounded_facts: Snow White brings the wounded magpie to her mother, implicitly entrusting her with its initial treatment.
memories.memory_text: I watched as the Queen took the wounded magpie from Snow White, who had brought it in for help.

grounded_facts: A moment in the royal bedroom where the family attends to a wounded magpie brought by Snow White, revealing emotional undercurrents.
memories.memory_text: I stood in the doorway and noticed how frail the Queen looked as the family attended to the injured bird.

grounded_facts: The Queen uses a ribbon from Snow White's hair to bind the magpie's injured wing, beginning its healing process.
memories.memory_text: I watched from the doorway as the Queen took the wounded magpie and used a ribbon from Snow White's hair to bind its injured wing, beginning to heal it.

grounded_facts: The Queen delivers an emotional message to Snow White about inner beauty and future queenship.
memories.memory_text: I heard the Queen tell Snow White, 'You possess a rare beauty, my love. In here,' touching her heart, and speak of her future as Queen.

grounded_facts: William offers a distinctive red and white apple to Snow White but pulls it away at the last moment, biting it himself and provoking her to shove him off the tree.
William pretends to offer an apple to Snow White but eats it himself, mocking her expectation.
memories.memory_text: I picked a distinctive red and white apple and offered it to Snow White, making a show of it, but then pulled it away and took a big bite myself—I couldn't help grinning as I saw her frustration before she shoved me out of the tree.

grounded_facts: Snow White and William interact in the cloister garden while King Magnus and Duke Hammond observe from the balcony, combining personal and political layers.
memories.memory_text: I was in the cloister garden with Snow White while King Magnus and Duke Hammond watched from the balcony, and I could feel their eyes on us as we climbed the apple tree.

grounded_facts: A year after the queen's death, King Magnus walks with Snow White in the snow-covered garden, both visibly heartbroken, signaling ongoing mourning.
memories.memory_text: I saw King Magnus walking with Snow White in the snow-covered garden, both of them looking so heartbroken—it must have been a year since the queen passed, and the grief was still heavy.

grounded_facts: The battle reaches the castle courtyard, with Duke Hammond's knights fighting invaders.
memories.memory_text: I saw the courtyard overrun with fighting, Duke Hammond's knights struggling to hold back the invaders as chaos broke out around me.

grounded_facts: William grabs Snow White protectively as danger approaches.
memories.memory_text: I grabbed Snow White protectively when I saw danger approaching and we were both lifted onto horses.

grounded_facts: The portcullis closes, cutting off William and Snow White from each other as the Duke escapes with his son.
memories.memory_text: I saw the portcullis come down behind us, cutting me off from Snow White as my father carried me away.

grounded_facts: An armed assault on the castle during which invaders breach the courtyard and key characters are separated.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Snow White struggling in Finn's arms as he hauled her back into the castle, and then the portcullis slammed shut, separating us during the assault.

grounded_facts: After knocking Snow White off the horse, Finn takes hold of her and pulls her back into the castle.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn grab Snow White and pull her back into the castle as I was being taken away.

grounded_facts: Duke Hammond informs William that the Princess, long believed lost, has escaped Ravenna's captivity and fled into the dark forest.
memories.memory_text: I was told the Princess, who we thought was lost, had escaped Ravenna and run into the dark forest, and I felt a surge of hope and fear at the news.

grounded_facts: William rejects his father's command not to enter the dark forest, asserting his intent to go alone if necessary.
memories.memory_text: I told my father I would go into the dark forest alone if I had to, and I meant it—I won't abandon her again.

grounded_facts: Upon learning the Princess escaped into the dark forest and is possibly alive, William resolves to find her despite his father's objections and the danger involved.
memories.memory_text: I decided right then that I would find her, no matter the danger or my father's warnings, because I couldn't abandon her again.

grounded_facts: A private meeting between William and Duke Hammond in the castle's war room where critical news about the Princess is delivered.
memories.memory_text: I remember the urgent meeting in the war room when my father called me and told me about the Princess escaping Ravenna's captivity and fleeing into the dark forest.

grounded_facts: William leaves the vicinity of Duke Hammond's stronghold on horseback at dawn.
memories.memory_text: I galloped away from the castle walls under the cover of the breaking dawn, leaving Duke Hammond's stronghold behind.

grounded_facts: Finn assembles a crew of woodsmen for a bounty mission into the dark forest.
Finn chooses Aldan, Broch, and others to form a bounty hunting crew for the dark forest mission.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn pick Aldan, Broch, and others from the woodsmen, pointing and saying 'You. You. You.' before telling them to load up and ride into the dark forest for bounty.

grounded_facts: William kills Finn's bowman with two precise arrows to prove his capability.
memories.memory_text: I killed his bowman with two arrows to the throat before he could even loose one, then lowered my bow and said, 'I said do you need a bowman?'

grounded_facts: William disobeys Finn's order to leave and forces a confrontation by blocking the path.
memories.memory_text: I asked Finn if he needed a bowman, and when he told me to leave, I stood my ground and didn't move, blocking his path even as he shouted at me.

grounded_facts: William states his desire to join Finn's crew for financial reasons.
memories.memory_text: I told Finn I want to ride with his crew because he's paying well and I need the coin.

grounded_facts: Finn questions William's lack of experience in the Dark Forest but acknowledges his archery speed.
memories.memory_text: Finn questioned whether I was any use since I haven't traversed the Dark Forest, and I reminded him that I'm quick with a bow.

grounded_facts: William confronts the bounty hunters on the road in the rain, challenges their formation, and earns a place by force and skill.
memories.memory_text: I stood in the rain and blocked the road, challenging Finn's crew; Broch told me to clear the path but I didn't move, and when he drew his axe, Finn stopped him and questioned my skill and purpose—I told him I'm quick with a bow and need the coin, and after a moment he nodded, accepting me.

grounded_facts: Finn accepts William into the bounty hunting crew after witnessing his speed and precision with a bow.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn consider my offer, and when he nodded and said 'Replace him,' I knew he accepted me into the crew because of my speed and precision with the bow.

grounded_facts: William reacts with panic as he observes the burning village.
memories.memory_text: I panicked when I saw the village burning around me.

grounded_facts: Snow White urgently warns Anna to flee from the approaching mercenary.
memories.memory_text: I heard Snow White shout 'Run!' to Anna, warning her to flee from the mercenary.

grounded_facts: Snow White faces the mercenary and attempts to defend herself with a knife after he advances on her.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White face the mercenary and slash at him with a knife, but he knocked her down and advanced on her before I struck him with an arrow.

grounded_facts: A violent nighttime attack on Anna's hut in the Fenland village, involving mercenaries and resulting in a rescue.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the violent attack on Anna's hut in the Fenland village, where Snow White tried to defend herself and I had to intervene to rescue her.

grounded_facts: William arrives and shoots the mercenary with an arrow, interrupting the attack on Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I arrived in time and shot the mercenary with an arrow, stopping him from harming Snow White.

grounded_facts: Snow White experiences a moment of emotional recognition upon seeing William, suggesting a shared past.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White stare at me with recognition and uncertainty, as if seeing a ghost from her past.

grounded_facts: William acknowledges Snow White with a nod, indicating shared history.
memories.memory_text: I nodded to Snow White when I saw her, recognizing her from our past.

grounded_facts: Anna intervenes to pull Snow White away from the danger after William's arrow distracts the mercenary.
memories.memory_text: I saw Anna pull Snow White away through the smoke after my arrow must have distracted the mercenary, though I wasn't sure if she even recognized me.

grounded_facts: After rescuing Snow White, William starts to pursue her as she is pulled away through the smoke.
memories.memory_text: I started to follow Snow White as she was pulled away, moving after her through the swirling smoke.

grounded_facts: Finn moves toward William on horseback after seeing him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn spot me while I was searching for Snow White, and he rode toward me on horseback.

grounded_facts: William mounts his horse to continue searching for Snow White amid smoke-filled surroundings.
memories.memory_text: I mounted my horse again to keep searching for Snow White, riding through the thick smoke that made it hard to see.

grounded_facts: Finn inquires whether William has seen Snow White.
memories.memory_text: Finn asked me if I had seen her, and I told him no, my lord, hoping he wouldn’t lose hope.

grounded_facts: Finn shows intense anger upon learning Snow White has not been found.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn spit with fury when he learned I hadn’t found Snow White, and then he raced off frantically.

grounded_facts: An arrow pierces the white hart, causing it to roar in pain and flee, shattering the sanctuary and plunging the area into darkness.
Aldan shoots an arrow that pierces the white hart, disrupting the sacred moment and initiating conflict.
memories.memory_text: I saw an arrow fly through the air and pierce the white hart, making it roar in pain and flee as a fierce wind ripped through the sanctuary, plunging everything into darkness, and I realized Aldan was the one who shot it.

grounded_facts: Finn appears on horseback in the gathering darkness, resembling a demon god, prompting Eric to pursue him.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn appear on horseback in the gathering darkness, looking like a demon god, and Eric went after him.

grounded_facts: William rides into Aldan's horse, knocking him off balance and preventing a direct hit on Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I rode my horse into Aldan's, knocking him off balance just as he fired, and I saw the arrow miss Snow White and thud into a tree.

grounded_facts: After the attack, the group splits: Gus leads Snow White into the forest, Eric pursues Finn, William fights off dwarves and follows, while Aldan is held back.
memories.memory_text: After the attack, I rode in and knocked Aldan off balance just as he fired, saving Snow White; then Gus grabbed her and ran into the forest while the dwarves attacked us both, and once I fought them off, I rode after her.

grounded_facts: Gus physically pulls Snow White while running through the enchanted forest as danger approaches.
memories.memory_text: I saw Gus pulling Snow White as they ran through the enchanted forest while I was riding fast.

grounded_facts: William sees Gus and Snow White from horseback while galloping through the forest.
memories.memory_text: I spotted Gus and Snow White up ahead while I was galloping through the trees.

grounded_facts: Snow White prevents Gus from harming William, establishing William's safety.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White stop Gus just in time, her voice cutting through the tension as his axe froze inches from my eyes, and I knew I was safe because of her.

grounded_facts: Snow White recognizes William from the village, leading to an emotional reunion.
memories.memory_text: I remember Snow White saying she saw me in the village, and when I gasped out 'It's me. William,' I realized she finally recognized who I was.

grounded_facts: Gus throws himself in front of an arrow meant for Snow White and is mortally wounded.
memories.memory_text: I saw Gus throw himself in front of an arrow meant for Snow White and get hit.

grounded_facts: William shoots Aldan with an arrow, killing him, shortly after Aldan shoots at Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I shot Aldan with an arrow and killed him right after he attacked Snow White.

grounded_facts: As he dies, Gus whispers a promise of eternal loyalty to Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I saw Gus take an arrow meant for Snow White, and as he lay dying, I heard him whisper to her, 'I shan't leave you, Miss,' a final promise of loyalty.

grounded_facts: The dwarves gather around Gus's body to chant a prayer and mourn his death.
memories.memory_text: I saw the dwarves gathered around Gus's body, chanting a low prayer as they mourned his death.

grounded_facts: William introduces himself as Duke Hammond's son and states his purpose in seeking the princess.
memories.memory_text: I introduced myself to Eric as William, Duke Hammond's son, and told him I was looking for the princess.

grounded_facts: William asserts that he will take over protection of Snow White, directly challenging Eric's role.
memories.memory_text: I told Eric I was grateful for his help but made it clear that I would take over protecting Snow White from that point on.

grounded_facts: Eric challenges William's authority, leading to both drawing weapons.
memories.memory_text: Eric challenged me, questioning what the Duke's son was doing with the Queen's men, and we both drew our weapons in response.

grounded_facts: Snow White stops Eric from further confrontation with William by vouching for William as a friend.
memories.memory_text: Snow White stepped in and told Eric to leave me alone, saying I was their friend, which stopped the fight from going further.

grounded_facts: After Gus's death, the dwarves argue about whether to continue supporting Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I saw the dwarves arguing after Gus's death, and I heard Nion spit and walk away, angry, saying we always suffer when we fight for human causes.

grounded_facts: Muir delivers a speech invoking the dwarves' lost honor and inspires them to recommit to Snow White's cause.
Muir delivers a speech about redemption and pride, convincing the dwarves to stay with Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Muir deliver his speech, where he said Gus gave his life for Snow White and looked at us with such sorrow, reminding us of our honor and making me want to stay and fight.

grounded_facts: William verbally apologizes to Snow White for leaving her, showing vulnerability and remorse.
William expresses remorse for leaving Snow White, acknowledging his failure and expressing regret.
memories.memory_text: I apologized to Snow White, telling her I was sorry for leaving her and that I would have come back if I'd known she was alive, feeling the weight of my failure.

grounded_facts: Snow White responds to William's apology by absolving him of past abandonment, emphasizing his current presence.
memories.memory_text: I heard Snow White tell me that we were just children back then, and that what matters is I'm here now, which eased some of my guilt.

grounded_facts: Eric offers his hand to assist Snow White up a steep slope, which she accepts, demonstrating physical support.
Eric offers his hand to help Snow White climb a steep slope, which she accepts.
memories.memory_text: I saw Eric offer his hand to help Snow White up a steep slope, and she took it and let him help her climb.

grounded_facts: William experiences jealousy upon seeing Eric assist Snow White physically.
memories.memory_text: I felt jealous when I saw Eric helping Snow White up the slope.

grounded_facts: A group travels across elevated terrain, making decisions about movement and rest.
memories.memory_text: I saw the group moving across steep rocks and high ground, watching as others helped Snow White climb and hearing Beith announce we'd rest at the top of the hill.

grounded_facts: William admits he misjudged Eric and offers a handshake, marking a shift in their relationship from distrust to mutual respect.
William initiates a handshake to acknowledge his misjudgment of Eric, who reciprocates, establishing mutual respect.
memories.memory_text: I admitted to Eric that I misjudged him, and I offered my hand; he shook it and said he had misjudged me too, and in that moment, I knew we had earned each other's respect.

grounded_facts: William leans in and kisses Snow White during a moment of emotional intimacy, symbolizing his devotion.
memories.memory_text: I leaned in and kissed her gently, feeling the moment we shared, then pulled away and held out the apple just like when we were children, seeing her smile again.

grounded_facts: William expresses his enduring affection and devotion to Snow White during a private walk, reinforcing his emotional commitment.
memories.memory_text: I told Snow White I've thought about her constantly and can hardly believe I found her again, and I stepped closer, gazing into her eyes, wanting her to know how devoted I am.

grounded_facts: William takes Snow White on a walk into the silver birches at dawn, where he confesses his feelings and she is later poisoned.
memories.memory_text: I took Snow White for a walk into the silver birches at dawn, and as we talked, I saw the girl I once knew return in her eyes; I held out the apple just like when we were children, remembering how close we once were.

grounded_facts: The group camps overnight in the mountains; dwarves rest, while key conversations occur between William and Eric, and later William and Snow White leave for a walk.
memories.memory_text: I remember waking up when Eric shook me that night at camp, the dwarves still asleep around us, and knowing that even in stillness, important things were unfolding.

grounded_facts: Ravenna, who appeared to be about to remove Snow White's heart, is revealed to be an illusion as her body shatters into ravens; the real threat is dispelled by the Huntsman.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed Ravenna raise the knife to take Snow White's heart, but then her body exploded into ravens—I realized it was just an illusion, and I joined the Huntsman in fighting them off as they attacked us.

grounded_facts: William desperately commands the dwarves to save Snow White, showing his emotional breakdown.
memories.memory_text: I shouted at the dwarves to help her, grabbing Muir and begging him to do something—I couldn't accept that they weren't trying hard enough to save Snow White.

grounded_facts: Eric sees that William's sorrow matches his own, leading him to stop resisting his feelings.
memories.memory_text: I didn't notice at the time, but Eric must have seen how broken I was—he finally let go of his resistance, maybe because my sorrow mirrored his own.

grounded_facts: A confrontation in the mountains where Snow White is found frozen, Ravenna's illusion attempts to kill her, and she ultimately succumbs to the poison.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White frozen in the mountains, her eyes open but her body still, and when Ravenna appeared to cut out her heart, I thought it was real—until the Huntsman shattered her into ravens; we fought them off together, and I rushed to Snow White’s side, praying she could be saved, but in the end, I kissed her as the light left her eyes.

grounded_facts: William attempts to revive Snow White with a kiss, symbolizing love and hope.
memories.memory_text: I kissed Snow White, holding onto hope that it might be enough to bring her back—I had to try, even if I was afraid it wouldn't work.

grounded_facts: Despite efforts to revive her, Snow White dies as the poison fully takes effect, confirmed by the loss of light in her eyes and failed kiss from William.
memories.memory_text: I saw the light leave her eyes and felt nothing change after my kiss—I realized then, with everyone else, that she was truly gone.

grounded_facts: A public procession and mourning event for Snow White held at Duke Hammond's castle, where her body is displayed and mourned by allies.
Snow White's body, wrapped in a shroud, is placed on a funeral bier in the funeral chamber, marking the formal beginning of mourning rites.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Snow White's body, wrapped in a shroud, was laid on the funeral bier in the torchlit chamber; I led the mourning with tears in my eyes as Eric, the dwarves, and I accompanied her, and I saw the crowds come to grieve.

grounded_facts: A gathering of Duke Hammond and his lords in the courtyard tent to deliberate strategy, interrupted by William's impassioned appeal.
memories.memory_text: I stood before Duke Hammond and his council of lords in the courtyard tent, knowing I had to speak up while they debated behind walls.

grounded_facts: William passionately urges Duke Hammond and the council to act, asserting that Snow White's death must not be in vain and that they cannot remain passive.
memories.memory_text: I told them that Snow White died for our cause and that we cannot hide behind walls while this land suffers — I couldn't let her sacrifice be in vain.

grounded_facts: William directly opposes Duke Hammond's cautious stance, accusing him of inaction in the wake of Snow White's sacrifice.
memories.memory_text: I challenged Duke Hammond directly, accusing him of inaction, even though he said my grief clouded my judgment — but I had to hold him accountable.

grounded_facts: Snow White reappears alive in funeral robes, descending the stairs to the courtyard, shocking the assembly who believed her dead.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Snow White reappears alive in funeral robes, descending the stairs to the courtyard, shocking the assembly who believed her dead.

grounded_facts: A spontaneous assembly in the courtyard where Snow White appears and delivers a transformative speech, leading to a pledge of loyalty from the warriors.
memories.memory_text: I remember that A spontaneous assembly in the courtyard where Snow White appears and delivers a transformative speech, leading to a pledge of loyalty from the warriors.

grounded_facts: After resisting her decision, Duke Hammond bows to Snow White, symbolically accepting her leadership.
After Snow White's speech, Duke Hammond and then all the lords, knights, and warriors bow before her, symbolizing their loyalty and commitment to follow her.
memories.memory_text: I saw Duke Hammond resist Snow White's decision at first, but then he bowed to her, and I followed by bowing too, along with all the other lords, knights, and warriors, showing our loyalty and commitment to follow her into battle.

grounded_facts: Eric rides beside Snow White, makes a light-hearted remark, and bows in loyalty, showing his full commitment.
memories.memory_text: I saw Eric ride up beside Snow White and make a light-hearted remark, then bow in loyalty, showing he was fully committed to her cause.

grounded_facts: The Duke's army, now united under Snow White's cause, departs the castle gates at night, torches blazing, ready to confront Ravenna.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the Duke's army, now united under Snow White's leadership, depart the castle gates at night with torches blazing, ready to confront Ravenna.

grounded_facts: The army, now united and inspired, leaves the castle at night to confront Ravenna.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The army, now united and inspired, leaves the castle at night to confront Ravenna.

grounded_facts: The rebel army, including peasants, women, and soldiers, assembles on the dunes overlooking Ravenna's castle at dawn to plan the assault.
memories.memory_text: I saw our rebel army gather on the dunes at dawn, a mix of peasants, women, and soldiers, all ready to follow Snow White into battle.

grounded_facts: Snow White communicates a crucial piece of tactical knowledge to Duke Hammond, shifting the group's strategic outlook.
Snow White reveals that the castle portcullis will be open when the sun clears the horizon, providing a critical tactical opportunity.
memories.memory_text: I was there when Snow White told Duke Hammond that the portcullis would be open at dawn as the sun cleared the horizon, and I saw everyone turn to her in hope.

grounded_facts: William sees the castle through the smoke and notes the portcullis is still closed, indicating restricted access.
memories.memory_text: I saw the castle through the smoke while riding and noticed the portcullis was still down, blocking the way in.

grounded_facts: A combat situation at dawn where Snow White's group is trapped against the castle walls, under arrow fire, with the portcullis still down and enemy forces encircling.
memories.memory_text: I saw the archers on the walls firing down at us, arrows raining from above while we were pinned against the castle with the portcullis still closed and enemy forces closing in.

grounded_facts: Snow White refuses to retreat and reaffirms her promise to remain with her companions despite incoming arrows and danger.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White refuse to retreat and reaffirm her promise to stand with her companions, even as arrows flew around us.

grounded_facts: William tells Snow White to turn back, likely due to the immediate danger, but she refuses.
memories.memory_text: I told Snow White to turn back because of the danger, but she refused.

grounded_facts: The portcullis at the beach location rises, allowing passage.
memories.memory_text: I saw the portcullis shoot up at the beach, the dwarves hanging onto the counterweights for dear life.

grounded_facts: Snow White, Eric, and William ride through the open gates after the portcullis rises.
memories.memory_text: I galloped through the open gates with Snow White and Eric after the portcullis rose.

grounded_facts: Snow White rushes into the castle, triggering the closing of the trap by Ravenna's men.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White rush into the castle, and then Ravenna's men came out and closed the trap behind her.

grounded_facts: A combat encounter between Snow White's forces and Ravenna's men in the castle courtyard.
memories.memory_text: I fought alongside Eric in the courtyard, pushing forward with all my strength because we had to break through the roadblock.

grounded_facts: Eric, William, and their men engage in intense combat against Ravenna's forces blocking their path.
memories.memory_text: I fought alongside Eric and our men, pushing with all I had to break through Ravenna's forces blocking our path—we had to pass.

grounded_facts: Snow White enters the throne room and directly challenges Ravenna, initiating the final confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White storm into the throne room, breathing heavily, and shout 'It ends today... I have come for YOU!' as she confronted Ravenna.

grounded_facts: Ravenna derides Snow White upon her arrival, belittling her with a metaphor about a rose with a thorn.
memories.memory_text: I heard Ravenna mock Snow White as a rose with a thorn when she arrived.

grounded_facts: Snow White follows Ravenna into the mirror chamber, entering the space where the final battle will unfold.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White follow Ravenna into the mirror chamber, and I wanted to help her, but the shards from the ceiling turned into Dark Faeries that blocked my way.

grounded_facts: Ravenna uses her magic to transform shattered ceiling shards into three seven-foot-tall razor-sharp Dark Faeries, blocking Eric and William from aiding Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ravenna use her magic to turn the shattered ceiling into three towering, razor-sharp Dark Faeries that blocked me and Eric from reaching Snow White, with one rising right in front of me.

grounded_facts: While fighting for survival, Eric shouts a final command to Snow White to kill Ravenna, accepting his likely death.
Eric, in the midst of battle, shouts for Snow White to kill Ravenna, signaling his acceptance of death.
memories.memory_text: I saw Eric shout 'Kill her!' to Snow White while we were fighting the Dark Faeries, knowing he wouldn't make it out alive.

grounded_facts: Ravenna physically restrains Snow White and forces her to watch the slaughter of her allies, blaming her for their deaths.
memories.memory_text: I saw Ravenna pin Snow White down and force her to watch us die, blaming her for leading us to our deaths.

grounded_facts: The climactic confrontation between Snow White and Ravenna, accompanied by the battle of their allies in the throne room.
memories.memory_text: I was trapped with Eric and the others, blocked by the black shards that came from the ceiling, and I watched helplessly as Snow White fought her way up the stairs, got thrown across the mirror room, and slid under the archway dazed while Eric tried to survive the Faerie attacks.

grounded_facts: A sentient construct of shards forms into a Faerie and violently throws William onto a banquet table, causing it to shatter and William to be severely injured.
memories.memory_text: I was overwhelmed by a swarm of shards that formed into a Faerie, lifting me up before violently throwing me onto a banquet table—it shattered, and I remember bouncing like a rag doll from the impact.

grounded_facts: The Faerie shard construct kills or severely injures two soldiers during its descent, skewering one and impaling another into a pillar.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Faerie spin down and skewer one soldier while impaling another into a pillar, dragging him up into the stone.

grounded_facts: A violent encounter in the throne room between Eric, William, and the Dark Faerie, marked by ambush, escalation, and desperate defense.
memories.memory_text: I remember seeing my comrades' bodies and rushing toward the mirror room, only to be attacked from behind while Eric was also moving in—I didn’t even see the Dark Faerie coming.

grounded_facts: The Dark Faerie ambushes William from behind, impaling him through his armor and slamming him into a pillar, incapacitating him.
The Dark Faerie claws William from behind through his armor, stopping him and slamming him into a pillar.
memories.memory_text: I felt a searing pain as something clawed through my armor from behind, impaling me and slamming me into a pillar, knocking me senseless.

grounded_facts: After attacking William, the Dark Faerie turns to face Eric, causing him to halt and attempt to retreat.
The Faerie spins its head 180 degrees to face Eric, causing him to stop and attempt to retreat.
memories.memory_text: I remember the Dark Faerie turning to face Eric after attacking me, and I saw it spin its head 180 degrees to confront him, making Eric stop and try to pull back.

grounded_facts: William, exhausted and bleeding, is on the ground and unable to fend off a dark creature approaching his face with sharp claws.
memories.memory_text: I remember that William, exhausted and bleeding, is on the ground and unable to fend off a dark creature approaching his face with sharp claws.

grounded_facts: William looks at Eric with desperation, silently begging for help.
memories.memory_text: I looked at Eric, desperate, begging him silently for help as the creature held me.

grounded_facts: Eric and William lock eyes, establishing a wordless agreement in the heat of battle.
memories.memory_text: I locked eyes with Eric, and in that moment, I knew we understood each other without words.

grounded_facts: Eric throws his sword and destroys the second dark faerie, freeing William from its grasp.
memories.memory_text: I saw Eric throw his sword and destroy the dark faerie, and then I was free from its grip.

grounded_facts: Eric picks up a sword and kills a dark faerie in front of him, causing it to shatter.

grounded_facts: The Queen walks in the snowy castle gardens, observes a miraculous rose, pricks her finger, and conceives the desire for a special child.
The Queen observes a rose blooming in the snow, which inspires her longing for a child with specific traits.

memories.memory_text: I walked through the snowy gardens and saw a rose blooming against the cold, which I found miraculous; when I reached for it, I pricked my finger and felt the pain as three drops of blood fell onto the snow, and in that moment, I thought how I would love to have a child as white as snow, with lips as red as blood, hair as black as a raven's wings, and with the strength of that rose.

grounded_facts: A newborn baby cries, indicating the fulfillment of the Queen's wish.
memories.memory_text: I heard a newborn's cry, and in that moment, I knew my deepest wish—for a child as white as snow, with lips red as blood, hair black as a raven's wings, and the strength of the rose—had finally been fulfilled.

memories.memory_text: I remember that After killing the king, Ravenna exits the royal bedroom and informs the guards that the king has retired.

grounded_facts: Ravenna's mother instructs her to drink the potion that will give her the power to survive.
memories.memory_text: I remember my mother telling me to drink the potion that would give me the power to survive, saying it would let me steal youth and beauty—the ultimate power and only protection.

grounded_facts: Ravenna acknowledges Finn as her brother upon his arrival at the castle.
memories.memory_text: I exited the castle with my lantern and saw dark figures entering, led by a tall warrior with pale eyes—Finn—who looked at me with devotion, and I welcomed him as my brother.

grounded_facts: Ravenna verbally recognizes Finn as her brother, establishing a familial relationship.
memories.memory_text: I verbally recognized Finn as my brother, telling him 'Welcome, brother,' to affirm our familial bond.

grounded_facts: Snow White discovers her father's lifeless body in the royal bedroom, realizing the betrayal by Ravenna.
memories.memory_text: I rushed to my father's chamber and saw Ravenna at the end of the corridor; when I entered the room, I found my father's lifeless body lying on the bed.

grounded_facts: After realizing Ravenna's betrayal, Snow White flees the scene.
memories.memory_text: I realized Ravenna had betrayed me, and after a moment of shock with tears in my eyes, I turned and fled the scene.

grounded_facts: Ravenna speaks to the mirror, invoking the Mirror Man, who emerges from its surface as a liquid reflection in her distorted image.
memories.memory_text: I stood before the mirror, calling out to it, and watched as the surface rippled and the Mirror Man emerged from the liquid reflection in my own distorted image.

grounded_facts: The Mirror Man affirms Ravenna as the fairest and most powerful, reinforcing her dominance.
memories.memory_text: I was told by the Mirror Man that I am the fairest and most powerful, that another kingdom falls to my glory and there is no end to my beauty and strength.

grounded_facts: As she is killed, Ravenna's mother issues a warning that the spell done by fairest blood can only be undone by fairest blood.
memories.memory_text: I remember my mother’s voice calling out as I was torn from her arms and dragged away — she warned me that the spell done by fairest blood can only be undone by fairest blood.

grounded_facts: Ravenna commands the guards to execute all wedding guests and nobles gathered in the courtyard.
memories.memory_text: I stood at the top of the stairs and looked out over the wedding guests begging for mercy, then I told the guards, 'To the sword,' knowing there would be no pardon.

grounded_facts: A gathering of wedding guests and nobles is forcibly detained in the courtyard under guard, turning a celebration into a site of execution.
memories.memory_text: I saw the wedding guests and nobles gathered in the courtyard, held there by my guards, and I addressed them from the top of the stairs before their execution.

grounded_facts: Ravenna calls out Finn by name, halting his escape with Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn trying to escape with Snow White, so I called out his name to stop him, and he obeyed me.

grounded_facts: Upon seeing Snow White held by Finn, Ravenna decides not to kill her but instead orders her imprisonment for potential future use.
memories.memory_text: When I saw Snow White in Finn's grasp, I decided she might be useful later because of her royal blood, so I ordered her locked away instead of killed.

grounded_facts: Ravenna stares at Snow White without blinking, creating a tense and strange atmosphere.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Ravenna stares at Snow White without blinking, creating a tense and strange atmosphere.

grounded_facts: A recurring, silent encounter where Ravenna watches Snow White from outside her cell during the night.
memories.memory_text: I watched Snow White from the shadows outside her cell again, as I have many times before. She slept, changed into a woman, while I remained unchanged. When she opened her eyes and saw me, we locked gazes—she knows this is not the first time, but I said nothing, gave nothing away.

grounded_facts: Snow White wakes up and locks eyes with Ravenna, asking 'Why?' — a moment suggesting a recurring psychological dynamic.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Snow White wakes up and locks eyes with Ravenna, asking 'Why?' — a moment suggesting a recurring psychological dynamic.

grounded_facts: Snow White breaks the silence with a direct emotional question, challenging Ravenna's actions.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Snow White breaks the silence with a direct emotional question, challenging Ravenna's actions.

grounded_facts: Ravenna does not respond to Snow White's question and instead walks away, maintaining emotional control.
memories.memory_text: I stood before Snow White, watching her without blinking, then turned and walked away without answering—she didn’t deserve a response.

grounded_facts: Ravenna dismisses her generals' concerns about terrain and fortress strength, demanding extreme measures.
memories.memory_text: When my generals expressed concern about the mountains and fortress protecting the Duke, I dismissed their fears and demanded extreme measures to draw him out.

grounded_facts: Ravenna commands her generals to burn villages, poison wells, and display rebel heads on pikes to force the Duke out of hiding.
memories.memory_text: I commanded my generals to burn every village that supports the Duke, poison their wells, and put rebel heads on pikes to force him out of hiding.

grounded_facts: Ravenna declares her intention to personally interrogate two captured rebel leaders.
memories.memory_text: I declared that I wish to interrogate the captured rebel leaders myself, interrupting their scheduled execution.

grounded_facts: Ravenna undresses and submerges herself in a white, viscous liquid, emerging transformed like a statue.
memories.memory_text: I undressed and stepped into the white, viscous liquid, lowering myself beneath its surface and then rising again, transformed like a porcelain statue.

grounded_facts: Ravenna eats the heart of a dead songbird, a ritual act suggesting dark magic or symbolic nourishment.
memories.memory_text: I plucked the tiny heart from the dead songbird and ate it while listening to the reports, feeling its power sustain me.

grounded_facts: Ravenna holds a military strategy meeting with her generals while being attended in her bathing chamber.
memories.memory_text: I stood in my bathing chamber, attended by my maids, and met with my generals while they avoided looking at me directly; later, I was dressed and standing at the window with Finn at my side.

grounded_facts: Ravenna asks Finn if she is kinder than their past suffering warranted, reflecting on her moral identity.
memories.memory_text: I asked Finn if he remembered how we used to beg for scraps as children, looking at those starving peasants, and then I wondered aloud whether I’ve become kinder since then.

grounded_facts: Ravenna confronts two captured rebels, Thomas and Iain, in the throne room, assessing their motives before executing one and sparing the other.
memories.memory_text: I faced the two captured rebels, Thomas and Iain, after they ambushed my supply caravan; I stepped forward to examine them, intrigued by their defiance, and moved close to Iain to question his heart's strength despite his beauty and courage.

grounded_facts: Ravenna compliments Iain's beauty and courage only to emphasize the weakness of his heart before killing him.
Ravenna kills Iain by magically squeezing his heart until it bursts, demonstrating her power and cruelty.
memories.memory_text: I told Iain he had beauty and courage, but I questioned how strong his heart truly was before placing my hand on his chest and crushing it with my magic until it burst, proving that no mortal defiance can withstand my power.

grounded_facts: Ravenna stops Finn from beheading Thomas and instead allows him to return to the Duke as a messenger.
memories.memory_text: I stopped Finn from beheading Thomas and declared that he should return to the Duke to speak of my generosity, knowing fear would carry further if one lived to deliver the message.

grounded_facts: Ravenna confesses to Finn that her magical powers are weakening, revealing a rare moment of vulnerability.
memories.memory_text: I confessed to Finn that my powers are fading, though it pained me to admit such weakness.

grounded_facts: Finn delivers Rose to Ravenna in the mirror chamber, anticipating her need for rejuvenation.
memories.memory_text: I saw Finn enter the mirror chamber with Rose, understanding he had brought her for my rejuvenation.

grounded_facts: Ravenna restores her beauty and strength by magically devouring Rose's youth, causing Rose to age rapidly.
memories.memory_text: I took Rose by the throat and devoured her youth, feeling my strength and beauty return as she withered into an old woman.

grounded_facts: Ravenna performs a magical ritual in the mirror chamber to restore her youth by consuming Rose's life force.
memories.memory_text: I walked into the mirror chamber, afraid of what I’d see, then took Rose by the throat and consumed her life force to restore my youth, watching her wither as I bloomed again.

grounded_facts: Ravenna conducts a ritual inquiry with the Magic Mirror to confirm her status as the fairest, resulting in a pivotal revelation.
memories.memory_text: I performed the ritual, asking my Magic Mirror who the fairest was, watching the bronze ripple as the Mirror Man formed before me.

grounded_facts: The Mirror Man informs Ravenna that Snow White is more beautiful and the cause of her weakening power.
memories.memory_text: I was told by the Mirror Man that Snow White is more beautiful than I am, and that her beauty is tied to my weakening power.

grounded_facts: Ravenna summons Finn to carry out her new orders regarding Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I summoned Finn to carry out my new orders regarding Snow White.

grounded_facts: Ravenna discovers from the Magic Mirror that Snow White has surpassed her as the fairest, triggering a shift in her goals and emotional state.
memories.memory_text: I realized Snow White has surpassed me as the fairest, and in that moment, I felt my power slipping—I knew she must be dealt with before she becomes my undoing.

grounded_facts: Upon learning that Snow White's heart can grant immortality, Ravenna resolves to capture and kill her to obtain it.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Snow White's heart can grant immortality, so I resolved to capture and kill her to obtain it.

grounded_facts: Ravenna berates Finn for failing to protect her interests and allowing the girl to escape.
memories.memory_text: I shouted at Finn, reminding him that he swore to protect me and that the girl means everything to my future — because she truly does.

grounded_facts: Ravenna physically assaults Finn in anger after blaming him for failing to capture the girl.
memories.memory_text: I struck Finn hard across the face when I confronted him — I had to make him feel my anger for failing me.

grounded_facts: Finn pushes back against Ravenna's abuse, asserting his lifelong loyalty.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn cry out, 'Have I not given all to you?!' as he pushed back against my anger, reminding me of his lifelong loyalty.

grounded_facts: A private, high-tension encounter between Ravenna and Finn in the Mirror Chamber, involving accusations, violence, and reconciliation.
memories.memory_text: I remember striding in furious circles, the weight of my future crumbling because of Finn's failure. I screamed at him — 'This is everything!' — and when he looked at me with that wounded defiance, I struck him. And then, after the silence, he cried out, 'Have I not given all to you?!' — a plea that pierced through my rage.

grounded_facts: After Finn questions his service, Ravenna softens and heals his facial wound with a touch.
memories.memory_text: After Finn questioned his service, I softened, touched his face, and healed his wound with a mere touch—watching his expression shift to calm and acceptance, I knew he was mine again.

grounded_facts: Ravenna responds to Finn's defiance with tenderness and magical healing, reinforcing loyalty.
memories.memory_text: I responded to Finn's defiance with tenderness, whispering, 'Have I not given you all? All,' before raising my finger to touch his face—my magic healed his wound instantly, and I saw his calm return, reaffirming the bond only I can restore.

grounded_facts: Ravenna commands Finn to bring someone who knows the Dark Forest well to help hunt the girl.
memories.memory_text: I commanded Finn to bring me someone who knows the Dark Forest well, because I have no powers there and we must hunt the girl.

grounded_facts: A group of villagers is assembled by Finn's men to respond to the Queen's demand for a navigator of the Dark Forest.
memories.memory_text: I had Finn assemble a group of villagers to answer my demand for a navigator of the Dark Forest.

grounded_facts: Finn announces the Queen's demand for someone to navigate the Dark Forest and offers compensation, but no villager initially volunteers.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Finn announced my demand for a navigator of the Dark Forest and offered compensation, but no villager volunteered.

grounded_facts: Eric is summoned before Queen Ravenna, who demands he track down an escaped prisoner.
memories.memory_text: I summoned Eric before me and commanded him to find the escaped girl and bring her to me.

grounded_facts: Eric initially refuses Queen Ravenna's order to pursue the escaped prisoner in the Dark Forest, citing the danger and his past experience.
memories.memory_text: I remember Eric refusing my order, saying he wouldn't go back to the Dark Forest and that no coin was worth dying for.

grounded_facts: Eric directly questions Ravenna's right to command him and rejects her conditions.
memories.memory_text: I heard Eric challenge my authority directly, telling me he would decide what concerned him.

grounded_facts: Ravenna signals the guards to draw swords when Eric refuses her order, implying lethal consequences.
memories.memory_text: I signaled the guards to draw their swords when Eric defied me, showing him the consequence of disobedience.

grounded_facts: Eric grabs Ravenna by the throat after she taunts him about reuniting with his wife, showing raw emotional reaction.
memories.memory_text: I felt Eric's hands close around my throat, and I held his gaze, seeing the rage and pain in his eyes as he reacted to my words.

grounded_facts: Ravenna exploits Eric's grief over his dead wife to coerce him into accepting her mission.
Ravenna manipulates Eric by offering to bring back his deceased wife in exchange for retrieving the escaped girl.
memories.memory_text: I offered Eric a deal—he could have his wife back if he brought me the girl, and I told him I have the power to make it happen, that a life for a life is a fair exchange.

grounded_facts: Eric questions why Snow White is so valuable to the Queen.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Eric questioned why Snow White was so valuable to me, though I wasn't certain of his full reasoning.

grounded_facts: Snow White accuses Eric of being sent by the Queen to hunt her.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Snow White accused Eric of being sent by me to hunt her.

grounded_facts: Eric indicates familiarity with the Dark Forest, including its dangers and geography.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Eric knows the Dark Forest well, including its dangers and layout, because he pointed out where we were and mentioned a village we’d passed earlier.

grounded_facts: Ravenna crushes the single blossom on the dying apple tree, turning it into ash, symbolizing her determination and dark resolve.
memories.memory_text: I reached out and crushed the blossom in my hand, turning it into ash, feeling the weight of my resolve harden within me.

grounded_facts: Ravenna commands her forces to locate Snow White, marking a decisive shift in her pursuit.
memories.memory_text: I commanded my forces to find Snow White, knowing she must be located before she threatens my power again.

grounded_facts: The old woman stares at Ravenna without speaking, conveying something deeply unsettling that causes fear.
memories.memory_text: I passed an old woman who glanced at me, and when I confronted her, she just stared silently, shaking her head — there was something in her eyes that terrified me.

grounded_facts: Ravenna aggressively questions the old woman twice, escalating her tone, after believing she heard a whisper.
Ravenna turns back and aggressively demands to know what the old woman said, interpreting a perceived whisper as a provocation.
memories.memory_text: I turned back and demanded to know what the old woman said because I thought she whispered something, and when I saw something in her eyes that unsettled me, I shouted again to assert my authority.

grounded_facts: After confronting the old woman, Ravenna is terrified by her silent stare and flees.
memories.memory_text: I was so frightened by her silent stare that I backed away and scurried off, unable to face her any longer.

grounded_facts: Ravenna observes a tuft of hair caught on the gilded edge of the crown, which prompts her to touch a bald patch on her own head, suggesting a personal connection or realization.
memories.memory_text: I saw a tuft of hair caught on the gilded edge of my crown and slowly touched the bald patch on the side of my head, feeling the connection between them.

grounded_facts: Overcome with emotion upon realizing the hair on the crown may be her own, Ravenna shouts Finn's name in anguish, echoing through the palace.
memories.memory_text: Overcome with anguish, I shouted for Finn, my voice echoing through the palace, needing him in that moment of distress.

grounded_facts: Ravenna cries out in distress to Finn as she loses their connection.
memories.memory_text: I cried out to Finn as our connection tore away — 'Finn... no!' — feeling the loss like a wound.

grounded_facts: Ravenna experiences a physical and magical convulsion as she severs or loses her magical link to Finn, leading to her rapid aging and collapse.
memories.memory_text: I convulsed violently when the link to Finn broke, ink spilling everywhere, and I fell to the floor, writhing as my strength faded and I began to age rapidly.

grounded_facts: Finn speaks to Eric in his final moments, expressing a sense of impending death.
memories.memory_text: I heard Finn speak his last words, calling out to me and then telling Eric he felt something, just before he died.

grounded_facts: Finn dies after the magical connection to Ravenna is severed, as his wounds stop healing and he ceases to live.
memories.memory_text: I felt the connection to Finn sever, and I saw the life leave his eyes as his wounds stopped healing.

grounded_facts: Eric frees himself from the branches that were cutting into his flesh, following Finn's death.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Eric must have freed himself from the branches cutting into his flesh after Finn died, taking advantage of the moment.

grounded_facts: Ravenna transitions from a state of depletion and sorrow to one of intense conviction, hatred, and determination.
memories.memory_text: I was so drained, my head down and still, but then I felt the hatred rise—I saw it in my hands, in the ink, and I knew I would not stay broken.

grounded_facts: Ravenna verbally declares that someone will pay, indicating a commitment to retribution.
memories.memory_text: I said it aloud, 'You will pay. You will pay!!!'—I meant every word, and I committed myself to vengeance in that moment.

grounded_facts: Ravenna performs a ritualistic act where she raises her arms, commands ravens into flight, and becomes one with their swirling formation, symbolizing unity with her magical constructs.
memories.memory_text: I raised my arms and commanded the ravens to take flight, feeling the surge of magic as I became one with their swirling formation around me.

grounded_facts: Snow White is tricked into eating a poisoned apple by a disguised Ravenna, leading to her collapse and apparent death.
Disguised as William, Ravenna offers a poisoned apple in a nostalgic reenactment, tricking Snow White into consuming it.
memories.memory_text: I tricked Snow White by disguising myself as William and offering her a poisoned apple, just like in their childhood moment—I saw her smile as she took it from me, and when she bit into it, I watched her collapse in the snow before revealing my true form in triumph.

grounded_facts: William takes Snow White on a walk into the silver birches at dawn, where he confesses his feelings and she is later poisoned.
memories.memory_text: I revealed my true form to Snow White as she collapsed in the snow, choking from the poison, and I saw the horror in her blurring eyes as my triumph burned through the disguise.

grounded_facts: Ravenna, who appeared to be about to remove Snow White's heart, is revealed to be an illusion as her body shatters into ravens; the real threat is dispelled by the Huntsman.
memories.memory_text: I was about to cut out Snow White's heart when my form suddenly shattered — I felt myself breaking apart into ravens as the Huntsman's blow dispersed me, my illusion torn apart before I could finish.

grounded_facts: A confrontation in the mountains where Snow White is found frozen, Ravenna's illusion attempts to kill her, and she ultimately succumbs to the poison.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White frozen before me, her eyes wide and breath faint, so I leaned in close, knowing the moment had come to take her heart and end her threat — I raised my knife, ready to strike.

grounded_facts: Ravenna materializes in the mirror room by transforming a swarm of ravens into her human form, visibly weakened by the effort.
memories.memory_text: I pulled myself together from the swarm of ravens, feeling the strain in every limb as I collapsed onto the floor, weakened by the transformation.

grounded_facts: Ravenna shouts at the mirror, demanding to know where Snow White has been taken.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Ravenna shouts at the mirror, demanding to know where Snow White has been taken.

grounded_facts: Ravenna demands answers from the mirror about Snow White's location but receives no useful response, culminating in a quiet plea for help.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Ravenna demands answers from the mirror about Snow White's location but receives no useful response, culminating in a quiet plea for help.

grounded_facts: The Mirror Man mocks Ravenna's plea for help, calling her desperation pathetic and expressing disgust.
memories.memory_text: I begged the Mirror Man for help, and I heard him mock my plea, calling my desperation pathetic and saying I sicken him.

grounded_facts: The Mirror Man speaks from the mirror, mocking Ravenna's desperation and expressing disgust toward her.
memories.memory_text: I saw and heard the Mirror Man speak from the mirror, mocking me and showing his disgust at my desperation.

grounded_facts: A tense encounter between Ravenna and the Mirror Man in the mirror room, where Ravenna seeks information and is met with rejection and mockery.
memories.memory_text: I crawled toward the mirror and demanded answers—where they had taken her, what I must do—but the Mirror Man only mocked me, repeating my plea with contempt before telling me I sicken him.

grounded_facts: Snow White redefines her relationship with the people, declaring that they inspire her and that she will fight alongside them.
memories.memory_text: I heard Snow White declare that I inspire her, that she’s not a leader or warrior, but that the people’s courage shapes her—she said she’d give her life for them, and ride to meet me whether alone or with an army.

grounded_facts: Snow White announces her intention to ride into battle against the Queen, asserting she is the only one who can defeat her.
memories.memory_text: I saw her announce she would ride to battle me, claiming she is the only one who can defeat me—she said it boldly, and when I looked into the mirror, I knew she meant to face me directly.

grounded_facts: Snow White reappears alive in funeral robes, descending the stairs to the courtyard, shocking the assembly who believed her dead.
memories.memory_text: I raised my head to look into the mirror just as Snow White reappeared alive in funeral robes, descending the stairs to the courtyard, shocking everyone who believed her dead.

grounded_facts: Ravenna absorbs the life force of the crones, restoring her youth and vitality in preparation for battle.
memories.memory_text: I absorbed the life force of the crones, feeling my youth and strength return as I prepared to face Snow White.

grounded_facts: A spontaneous assembly in the courtyard where Snow White appears and delivers a transformative speech, leading to a pledge of loyalty from the warriors.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Snow White must have delivered a transformative speech to the assembly, because afterward the warriors pledged their loyalty to her.

grounded_facts: Eric rides beside Snow White, makes a light-hearted remark, and bows in loyalty, showing his full commitment.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Eric fully committed himself to Snow White, riding beside her and bowing in loyalty, though I was not there to hear his words myself.

grounded_facts: The army, now united and inspired, leaves the castle at night to confront Ravenna.
memories.memory_text: I witnessed the army, now united and inspired, leave the castle at night to confront me, their torches blazing like a river of fire across the valley.

grounded_facts: The Duke's army, now united under Snow White's cause, departs the castle gates at night, torches blazing, ready to confront Ravenna.
memories.memory_text: I saw the Duke's army pour out of the castle gates at night, torches blazing like a river of fire, moving across the plain — they are united under Snow White and coming for me.

grounded_facts: A nighttime meeting on the queen's balcony where the Black Knight General updates Ravenna on the approaching rebel army.
memories.memory_text: I was on the balcony that night when the general came to report to me.

grounded_facts: The general informs Ravenna that the rebel forces are a half day's march away and growing in number.
memories.memory_text: The general told me the rebel forces were a half day's march away and growing in number.

grounded_facts: Ravenna dismisses the general's report and insults him, blaming him for failure.
memories.memory_text: I dismissed his map and told him he was a fool, blaming him for failing me when he mentioned deserters.

grounded_facts: Ravenna realizes that Snow White is leading the approaching forces, reigniting her obsession with obtaining Snow White's heart.
memories.memory_text: I realized then that Snow White was leading the rebels, and my need for her heart flared again.

grounded_facts: Ravenna declares that the approaching rebels may be destroyed, but Snow White must be captured alive for her heart.
memories.memory_text: I declared that the rebels could be destroyed, but Snow White must be captured alive—I need her heart still warm with blood.

grounded_facts: Ravenna observes the banners of the rebel army on the distant cliffs, signaling their presence and proximity.
memories.memory_text: I saw the banners of the rebel army on the distant cliffs, signaling they were near.

grounded_facts: A ray of sunlight illuminates Snow White's small figure in the distance, marking her as a focal point.
memories.memory_text: I noticed a ray of sunlight illuminating Snow White's small figure in the distance, as if marking her out.

grounded_facts: Ravenna issues a commanding call for Snow White to come to her, asserting dominance or control.
memories.memory_text: I called out to Snow White with a commanding voice, telling her to come to me.

grounded_facts: Ravenna's archers move into their designated spots, preparing for battle.
Missiles are loaded onto the trebuchets by the artillery men, indicating escalation of military readiness.
memories.memory_text: I watched my archers move into their positions and saw the artillery men loading missiles onto the trebuchets, preparing for battle.

grounded_facts: A battle taking place at Ravenna's castle, where her forces engage Snow White's army at the portcullis.
memories.memory_text: I watched from the balcony as my soldiers fought at the portcullis, knowing they were just pawns to slow her down.

grounded_facts: Ravenna issues a direct order that Snow White must be captured alive, indicating her strategic intent to confront her personally.
Ravenna issues a forceful command that Snow White must be brought to her alive, asserting dominance and intent.
memories.memory_text: I commanded that Snow White be brought to me alive—I need her heart, and I will have it myself.

grounded_facts: It is revealed that Ravenna has orchestrated the entire battle, using her soldiers not to win but to delay Snow White's army.
memories.memory_text: I orchestrated the entire battle, calculating every move to delay her army and draw her to me.

grounded_facts: Snow White engages in combat with the Tortoise Formation soldiers to reach the side door of the castle.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White fighting the soldiers of the Tortoise Formation as she tried to reach the side door.

grounded_facts: Snow White moves through a burning area to reach the side door of the castle.
memories.memory_text: I watched her move through the burning area to get to the side door of the castle.

grounded_facts: Ravenna departs from the balcony to the throne room, showing calm and calculation despite her soldiers' situation.
memories.memory_text: I calmly left the balcony and moved toward the throne room, keeping my composure even though I knew my soldiers were struggling.

grounded_facts: Eric, William, and their men engage in intense combat against Ravenna's forces blocking their path.
memories.memory_text: I inferred that Eric, William, and their men were fighting fiercely against my forces at the roadblock, pushing forward and gaining ground in the courtyard.

grounded_facts: Snow White enters the throne room and directly challenges Ravenna, initiating the final confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I stood at the top of the stairs in the throne room when Snow White stormed in, breathing heavily, and shouted, 'It ends today... I have come for YOU!'

grounded_facts: Ravenna derides Snow White upon her arrival, belittling her with a metaphor about a rose with a thorn.
memories.memory_text: I mocked Snow White when she arrived, calling her my rose with a thorn as I looked at the small sword she carried.

grounded_facts: Ravenna uses her magic to transform shattered ceiling shards into three seven-foot-tall razor-sharp Dark Faeries, blocking Eric and William from aiding Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I used my magic to transform the shattered ceiling shards into three seven-foot-tall, razor-sharp Dark Faeries, blocking Eric and William from reaching Snow White.

grounded_facts: Snow White follows Ravenna into the mirror chamber, entering the space where the final battle will unfold.
memories.memory_text: I led Snow White into the mirror chamber, and she followed me without hesitation, stepping right into the trap I set for her.

grounded_facts: While fighting for survival, Eric shouts a final command to Snow White to kill Ravenna, accepting his likely death.
Eric, in the midst of battle, shouts for Snow White to kill Ravenna, signaling his acceptance of death.
memories.memory_text: I heard Eric shout 'Kill her!' while I effortlessly threw Snow White aside, knowing he was accepting his end as he commanded her to attack me.

grounded_facts: Ravenna physically restrains Snow White and forces her to watch the slaughter of her allies, blaming her for their deaths.
memories.memory_text: I held Snow White down and forced her to watch William and his men being slaughtered, making her see that her hope led them to their deaths.

grounded_facts: The climactic confrontation between Snow White and Ravenna, accompanied by the battle of their allies in the throne room.
memories.memory_text: I saw the black shards circle around Eric and his men, blocking them from helping Snow White, and with little effort I threw her across the room while Eric struggled to survive by ramming a Faerie into a pillar.

grounded_facts: Ravenna overpowers Snow White, twists her wrist until her bones crack, and forces her to drop the sword.
memories.memory_text: I overpowered Snow White, twisted her wrist until her bones cracked, and forced her to drop the sword—her pain was palpable, her strength no match for mine.

grounded_facts: Despite pain and injury, Snow White declares she will defeat Ravenna.
memories.memory_text: I heard Snow White, through gritted pain, declare directly to me that she would defeat me.

grounded_facts: Ravenna backhands Snow White, sending her crashing into the wall, causing facial cuts.
memories.memory_text: I backhanded Snow White so hard she crashed into the wall, cuts appearing on her face from the impact.

grounded_facts: Ravenna tells Snow White she was never ready and is just a child, mocking her attempt to defeat her.
memories.memory_text: I told Snow White she was never ready, that she's just a child trying to challenge me—I've lived many lives and wield powers she can't fathom.

grounded_facts: Ravenna stands in fire unharmed and summons black shards that cover the walls, entombing the chamber in darkness.
memories.memory_text: I stood in the fire and felt no pain as my skin blistered and healed, then raised my arms to summon black shards that covered the walls and entombed the chamber in darkness.

grounded_facts: The climactic physical and emotional showdown between Snow White and Ravenna in the Mirror Chamber.
memories.memory_text: I faced Snow White in the Mirror Chamber, where her desperate attacks met my bare hands—I parried each one, seized her, twisted her wrist until she screamed and dropped her sword, then struck her down and loomed over her through the fire, laughing as I declared it over. She stared defiance, but she was broken.

grounded_facts: Despite injury and exhaustion, Snow White stands and maintains her defiance against Ravenna.
memories.memory_text: I saw her struggle to stand, bloodied and broken, yet she held my gaze without fear—I could feel her refusal to yield.

grounded_facts: Ravenna grabs Snow White by the throat and slams her onto the stone floor, initiating a lethal confrontation.
memories.memory_text: I remember that Ravenna grabs Snow White by the throat and slams her onto the stone floor, initiating a lethal confrontation.

grounded_facts: Ravenna speaks a spell incantation as she attempts to kill Snow White.
memories.memory_text: I spoke the incantation, 'By fairest blood it is done!', certain it would end Snow White, only to feel her dagger plunge into my chest as she fought back.

grounded_facts: Snow White whispers a reversal of Ravenna's spell, symbolically declaring the end of her power.
memories.memory_text: I was told that Snow White whispered a reversal of my spell, declaring the end of my power.

grounded_facts: Snow White blocks Ravenna's dagger strike, takes the dagger, and stabs Ravenna in the chest, causing her to die and age rapidly.
memories.memory_text: I saw Snow White block my dagger strike, take the weapon, and stab me in the chest, and I felt my blood fall onto her armor.

grounded_facts: The climactic battle between Snow White and Ravenna in the Mirror Chamber, resulting in Ravenna's death.
memories.memory_text: I remember that The climactic battle between Snow White and Ravenna in the Mirror Chamber, resulting in Ravenna's death.

grounded_facts: After being stabbed, Ravenna ages rapidly and dies; her death causes the magical black tomb to shatter.
memories.memory_text: After being stabbed, I felt myself age rapidly, saw my body fail, and watched the black tomb shatter as I died.

grounded_facts: Ravenna physically ages dozens of years in seconds upon losing her power, showing no resistance or anger.
memories.memory_text: I felt my body weaken and age rapidly, becoming old in seconds, as I lost my power and accepted what was happening.

grounded_facts: Ravenna gently taps Snow White in a motherly way, expressing unexpected tenderness.
memories.memory_text: I gently tapped Snow White in a motherly way, feeling an unexpected warmth and tenderness toward her in that moment.

grounded_facts: Ravenna whispers to Snow White that they are bound, acknowledging a deep, inevitable connection between them.
memories.memory_text: I whispered to Snow White that we are bound, seeing the truth of our connection in her eyes.

grounded_facts: Snow White places her hand on Ravenna's chest and whispers calming words as Ravenna dies.
memories.memory_text: I felt Snow White place her hand on my chest and whisper calming words to me, and I placed my hand on hers in response.

grounded_facts: The climactic encounter between Snow White and Ravenna concludes not with violence, but with compassion and death.
memories.memory_text: I remember how it ended—not with rage or violence, but with Snow White’s compassion and my quiet passing, as the light left my eyes.

grounded_facts: Ravenna dies peacefully after a moment of connection with Snow White, acknowledging their bond.
memories.memory_text: I felt Snow White's hand on my chest and placed my hand on hers, smiling as I saw her face in the light above; I felt no anger, only understanding, and when she whispered that it would be all right, I let go and died peacefully.

memories.memory_text: I remember the blood falling on the snow—three drops like cannon fire—and how the Queen touched her stomach, quiet and still, after pricking her finger on the rose.

I remember the winter after the queen died—it was the worst in years, and the garden lost its rose. The king walked in the snow with his arm around the girl, both of them broken, and I knew then that the kingdom had begun to fall.
I threw my hatchet and missed on purpose, letting Broch think he had me—then he swung and buried his axe in the oak, just like I knew he would.
After I knocked Broch out, I searched his pockets, then looked at the girl—Rose—and when I lifted her chin, she smiled back like she wanted more; so I grabbed her and threw her over my shoulder.
I remember the merchant finally saying ten gold pieces, and how I paused not because I doubted, but because I was making sure he meant it—then I turned and took the deal.
I grabbed her by the throat when she mentioned my wife—something in her expression, like she was enjoying it, made me let go fast.
She said she could bring Sara back—a life for a life—and for a second, I wanted to believe her more than anything.
I stepped carefully on the grassy stones, feeling each one give way beneath my boot—told the others to do exactly as I did, no room for mistakes in that mire.
I saw the faint footprints in the dew, bent down to confirm—they were fresh. Started moving faster then, knowing we were no longer just traveling, but chasing.
I felt it before I saw it—the wrongness in the air—so I stopped and held up my hand, then moved fast ahead of the others. They hesitated, but I couldn’t wait.

I asked her why the Queen wants her dead, and when she said the Queen wants them all dead, I pressed—what makes you so damn valuable? That’s when I started seeing there’s more to this than just another hunt.
She said I'd be rewarded if I took her to the Duke’s Castle, and that I’d be dead if I returned without her. I walked away, but she followed. I didn’t answer, but I stopped.
I heard my name and saw Sara behind the rocks. I called out to her, wondering if I was dreaming, and started walking toward her.

I smelled the dropping, worked it between my fingers, and knew right away—fumee. When I saw the sign, I told Snow White to stay put and moved ahead to track it, even though my head was still ringing from what I'd seen.

I turned and saw the figures rising from the marsh banks, arrows drawn, and pulled my axe—stepped in front of Snow White before she could say anything. I didn’t know if they were friend or foe, only that they blocked every way out.

I walked away from the hut, knowing she was better off without me. When Anna confronted me, I told her the truth—everything I’ve ever cared about got destroyed, and I won’t let it happen to Snow White.
I was moving away from the village when I saw the sky light up behind me—burning arrows raining down. I turned and ran back without thinking.
I arrived and saw the village already burning—smoke thick in the air, flames eating the huts, people screaming. The first mercenary never saw me coming.
After dropping the first one, I didn't stop—two more came at me, swinging wild. I took them down fast, one after the other, moving through the smoke and blood.
I grabbed Snow White and pulled her away from the flames—she was fighting me, but I couldn't let her go back. Anna shouted for her to go, and I knew we had no time.
I saw Broch step out of the dark, axe in hand, grinning like this was some kind of game—so I dropped Snow White’s hand, moved fast, and put both hatchets in his ribs before he could swing again.
I told her I led them to the village. I am to blame. The words came out raw, but I couldn't look at her when I said them.
I didn't see them coming. One second I was looking at the sun through the trees, the next—fists, boots, masks. Then I was hanging upside down, blood rushing to my head, no weapon, no chance.
I saw Gort and Nion sing and share rum before they fell to the ground. I chuckled. I said the Queen took their pride when she seized their mines.
I was tracking the sound of hooves, bow ready, when they stopped dead—I turned, saw Finn’s horse charging past, riderless. That’s when I knew I’d been fooled.
I barely had time to spin around before Finn came out of the dark and hit me with his sword—just a glancing blow, but it caught me off guard.
I heard him say her name—Sara—and that she called for me before he killed her. The sound of it ripped something open inside me.
I drove us both into the spiked branches—felt the wood tear into my back as I slammed Finn into them. It didn't matter. Nothing did.
I saw Finn twitch, his eyes finding mine—he tried to say something, then went still. That’s when I started pulling myself free from the branches tearing into my arms.

I saw William step forward claiming he’d take Snow White from me, so I told him he’d need a man’s voice to give me orders — then we both drew steel, and I made sure he knew drawing a weapon means nothing unless you’ve got the will to use it.
I swung my twin hatchets into the flock of ravens, hacking at the shrieking birds as they swarmed around me, tearing at my face and eyes.
I knelt beside her and saw the poison drain the color from her lips; when the light in her eyes went out, I just stared—I couldn't move, couldn't speak.

I told her the truth about Sara—how I came back from the wars poisoned inside, how my wife saved me even though I wasn't worth saving, and how Snow White brought that part of me back until she was gone too.
I brushed the hair from her face, kissed her lips, and walked away—tossing my flask aside like it meant nothing, like I meant nothing.
I saw the firelights rise from the castle walls and knew they were missiles—no time to explain, I just yanked Snow White's horse aside as the fireball exploded nearby.

You both deserved better. And I'm sorry to have failed you as well.
